name: Assumptions
rows: Each one is the Controller's to confirm (CF-8). The flagged ones are also findings.
The November 5 batch is approved by the Controller and the CFO and released on November 5 (PAY-8).

Held bills are released when the AP clerk expects: MLE-1401 after the call-back (November 12 run), SWR-8133 when the lien waiver arrives and KRE-2207 less the $1,950.00 delivery credit (November 19 run).
Bills on approval, W-9 and document holds from the AP review are cleared before their due dates and paid on time.
Payroll after November 6 is funded at the latest approved amount; the calendar's dates hold, including December 31 for the January 1 holiday.
The construction loan rate stays at 6.25% (prime plus 1.25%) through December.
Draws 9 and 10 are submitted, inspected and funded in full on the draw log's dates.
The steel balance on PO-27-0511 is paid by wire on delivery, December 8, as the signed order says.
Contract payments fund on the billing schedule's dates at the estimated net payment; Site 27 is left out until its contract is signed.
No early-pay discount is assumed after the November 5 batch; each run decides them under PAY-2.
Bank interest credits are not forecast; utilities and the service charge repeat October's amounts on each month's last business day.
Granite Point Business Park (27-07) is paid from operating cash; it is not financed under CL-2025-07.
